description: A generator wrote a text for an item: the whole result (4.3, third rule), made here or pulled from another device. The place that shows it (a chat's title, a day's summary, a suggested value) follows this.

id.description: The generator and the item, as <generator>:<item>.

generator.description: Which generator: fixed, one per kind.

item.description: What the text is about: a chat's id for chat-title, a journal day's date (YYYY-MM-DD) for journal-summary, a value's id for value-suggestion.

source.description: The SHA-256 of the content the text was made from; the item needs a new text only when its content gives another.
